models.L073: Cube A=6l²,V=l³,A/V=6/l. Flattened dimensions 4l,l,l/4 preserve volume. Length µm, area µm², volume µm³, ratio µm⁻¹. No real exchange-rate prediction or universal cell-size limit. Drawings not to scale.
models.L074: Representative diploid 2n=4. G1=2C; end-S/G2/metaphase=4C; each daughter=2C. Four chromosomes before anaphase; whole-anaphase count temporarily eight, four per pole. Checkpoint hold illustrates reduced risk, not guaranteed error detection. Equal frames are not equal biological durations; G0 exists.
models.L075: Five-stage school simplification merges prophase/prometaphase. Two homologous pairs A/a and B/b; suffix1/2 sisters. Ideal faithful replication, no new mutation, correct segregation. Error misdirects A2, yielding5:3. Equal totals do not prove complete identity sets. Original schematic omits spindle detail and plant cell plates.
models.L076: K/M/N/H fictional shared genome, ON/low qualitative expression, not universal deletion or complete on/off regulation. Representative living differentiated cell profiles, not mature dead cornified surface cells. Terminal chosen cells do not divide; basal epidermal stem/progenitor cells supply replacements. Progenitor availability is a hypothetical necessary supply condition, never a guarantee of repair or general adult neuronal regeneration; muscle anatomy/multinucleation omitted.
